country.name: Cabo Verde
country.jurisdictionNotice: Preschool, basic and secondary education, technical education and vocational training, national qualifications, and higher education have distinct competent services and regulators. School records must remain attached to the responsible education delegation, municipality, island, grouping and current legal act.
country.languagePolicy: Portuguese and the Cape Verdean language have distinct official, curriculum, oral, written and community roles. Island varieties and other learner language needs must not be collapsed into one generic translation.

review.policy: No category becomes verified without a named qualified Cabo Verde reviewer, current authoritative evidence and review by the competent ministry, delegation, ARES, SNQ, CNPD, ICCA or institution.

governanceModel.summary: The Ministry of Education, its National Directorate, Inspectorate and territorial delegations govern non-higher education; UC-SNQ and the employment and training authority govern distinct qualification and provider records; ARES regulates higher education; CNPD supervises personal-data protection; ICCA leads child-rights protection within its mandate.
governanceModel.schoolRule: Preserve school or grouping identity, island, municipality, education delegation, component establishments, sector, level, operating status, network act and update date. A contact page, SIGE record, statistical total or old network annex is not by itself a complete current school directory.
governanceModel.qualificationRule: An SNQ qualification, accredited training-provider licence, approval of a particular action, certificate homologation, RVCC decision, higher-education institution accreditation, study-cycle accreditation and foreign-degree recognition are separate claims.

authorities.name: Ministry of Education
authorities.role: education policy and oversight across preschool, basic, secondary and technical education

authorities.name: National Directorate of Education and Inspectorate-General of Education
authorities.role: curriculum, system administration, inspection and oversight within assigned mandates

authorities.name: Territorial Education Delegations
authorities.role: territorial coordination, school support, supervision, data validation and municipal liaison

authorities.name: Unit for Coordination of the National Qualifications System
authorities.role: QNQ and CNQ governance, occupational qualifications, equivalence and RVCC coordination

authorities.name: Directorate-General responsible for Employment and Vocational Training
authorities.role: accreditation of vocational-training providers within its mandate

authorities.name: Agency for Regulation of Higher Education
authorities.role: institutional and study-cycle evaluation, accreditation, inspection and foreign-degree recognition

authorities.name: Cabo Verdean Institute for Children and Adolescents
authorities.role: child-rights promotion and protection under the Child and Adolescent Statute

curriculum.authority: Ministry of Education through the competent national curriculum service
curriculum.title: Official curricular plans, programmes, learning goals and annual guidance
curriculum.implementationRule: Confirm subsystem, level, year, subject, curriculum plan, complementary programme, approving act, version, language, experimental or final status and effective school year. The formal basic plan explicitly excludes autonomous youth and adult basic education; annual orientation, strategic planning, a review process or an experimental Cape Verdean-language programme must not be expanded beyond its stated scope.
curriculum.supplementPolicy: Curricular plan, subject programme, learning target, annual orientation, teacher resource, assessment system, experimental programme and external resource are distinct layers.

schoolDirectory.authority: Ministry of Education, National Directorate and responsible territorial delegation
schoolDirectory.scopeNotice: The legal school network consists of groupings and non-grouped schools and is subject to periodic reordering; territorial delegations supervise schools and SIGE holds administrative data. A verified public, unified, current directory containing every component establishment, grouping, private or cooperative school, level, address and operating status was not located. The 2019 network annex and delegation contacts require current record validation.
requiredRecordFields: official grouping, school and component-establishment identity

educationStatistics.authority: Ministry education planning and statistics service and National Statistics Institute within their mandates
educationStatistics.scopeNotice: Every value must preserve observation or school year, publication date, level, definition, sector, island or municipality and source. Historical indicators and a 2021 national yearbook are not current 2026 figures; SIGE operational data require an authorized extract date and disclosure review.

vocationalQualifications.authority: UC-SNQ and competent employment and vocational-training authority
vocationalQualifications.authorityNotice: A qualification in the CNQ does not prove that every provider may deliver it. Verify the exact qualification and level, current accredited-provider licence and scope, training action notification, module completion, certificate homologation, double-certification or RVCC route and validity. An expired provider list must not be treated as current.

higherEducation.authority: Agency for Regulation of Higher Education
higherEducation.authorityNotice: Institution accreditation, accreditation and registration of an exact study cycle, location, degree, admission places, official decision reference, status such as accredited, conditional or discontinued, and validity year are separate claims. Foreign-degree recognition is a separate ARES process.

privacyAndSafeguarding.dataProtectionLaw: Law No. 133/V/2001 of 22 January, as amended and republished by Law No. 41/VIII/2013 of 17 September and amended by Law No. 121/IX/2021 of 17 March
privacyAndSafeguarding.childrenLaw: Child and Adolescent Statute approved by Law No. 72/X/2026 of 22 April
privacyAndSafeguarding.scopeNotice: Controller and processor duties, legal basis, notification or prior authorization, sensitive and biometric data, learner rights, transfers, security, retention, images and education-platform access require CNPD review. The new 2026 Child and Adolescent Statute requires current implementing, referral, safeguarding, participation and school-response procedures before real learner participation.

culturalAndLanguageRequirements.rule: Portuguese and the Cape Verdean language have distinct legal, oral, written, instructional and curriculum roles. Cape Verdean-language programmes must preserve the exact year, discipline, approved version, experimental or effective status, orthographic choice and island or community context. Automatic Portuguese translation is not reviewed Cape Verdean localization.

completionCriteria: A qualified Cabo Verde education reviewer is named.
National, delegation, inspection, SNQ, vocational-provider, ARES, CNPD and ICCA responsibilities are correctly assigned.
A verified unified current public school directory is documented or the directory gap remains visible.
Every school record preserves grouping and component identity, island, municipality, delegation, sector, status, act and update date.
Every statistic preserves observation year separately from publication date, together with definition, sector and geography.
Curriculum mappings preserve subsystem, level, year, subject, language, legal act, version and effective or experimental status.
Every vocational claim separates qualification, provider licence, training action and certificate route.
Every higher-education claim separately verifies institution, study cycle, location, degree, decision, status and validity.
Portuguese and Cape Verdean language resources preserve their distinct legal and educational context.
Privacy, the new child statute, accessibility, safeguarding, low-bandwidth, offline and incident procedures are approved before a real learner pilot.
